glosses: To incinerate a dead body (as an alternative to burial).

examples.text: I want to be cremated when I die.

“We cremated him, Benny. For humans, the word is cremated. And we chose to do that because that’s what they do in Japan.”

examples.text: Personne ne revit jamais ce Pussyfair, que j’incinérai moi-même au fond du parc, entre deux couches de feuilles mortes…
